notes: Indefinite subject with a verbal predicate correctly stays a witness rather than a generic, and the periodic 'every week' takes (Every e 1 week) with no tense atom and no QuantifierPhrase, as the frequency section specifies. Fusing village_square as a classifier compound (genus square, noun modifier not exposed) is a defensible reading of the compound rule, though the possessor/whole 'square of a village' reading is arguably available too.
